nodes.summary: activity/ollama_client.rs:77 gates on self.endpoint.starts_with("http://127.0.0.1:11434") and returns OllamaError::SecurityBlocked otherwise. The default endpoint in the Snipset database preferences is http://localhost:11434, so the guard is self-defeating for the app's own default configuration. The fix normalizes the check to accept http://127.0.0.1:11434, http://localhost:11434 and http://[::1]:11434 while keeping untrusted external hosts blocked.

nodes.label: reachesPlayAudio follows calls only, so a bare onClick={handler} reference is reported as a silent control
nodes.norm_label: reachesplayaudio follows calls only, so a bare onclick={handler} reference is reported as a silent control
nodes.summary: Reused id: same claim, measured independently in the A6 components group (chunk-rem-111 carries the A8 features/settings session's measurement of it). audioCueCoverage.test.ts:363-433 extracts the onClick body as the literal text {handleAllow}, then looks for /\bplayAudio\s*\(/ and for calls matching /\b([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*\(g. A bare reference has no trailing parenthesis, so nothing resolves and the control is reported as silent even though handleAllow calls playAudio("click_001.ogg") at line 88. The detector's separate `named` resolution path, used for toast detection, resolves the name but is not used by reachesPlayAudio. Here it is the root cause of most of the self-sounding exclusions, and this transcript records A5, A7 and A8 reporting the same limitation independently.
nodes.rationale: Stated reason the flag is a false positive rather than a real gap, and the consequence recorded for the queue owner:  [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-28 - wire-components-cues [ses_f17b1e0fdffegV5GBjL6DpbdNn].md:L02788] The `named` resolution (used for toast detection) resolves the name, but `reachesPlayAudio` does NOT resolve the named reference. So `onClick={handleAllow}` is a **detector limitation** — the handler is a bare function reference and the detector only follows calls, not references. [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-28 - wire-components-cues [ses_f17b1e0fdffegV5GBjL6DpbdNn].md:L09657] Detector limitation (root cause of most of my exclusions): `reachesPlayAudio` follows calls only; a bare `onClick={handler}` / `onSubmit={handler}` / prop / hook-return has no `name(` to match, so the detector reports already-cued controls as silent.

FloatingIcon.tsx:192 was said to be a drag handle -- it is the logo button, with the drag on onMouseDown at :133, which the detector does not consider, and the click bubbles to an ancestor that already cues.
